central_question: Can ORION learn recursively higher-order principles of scientific development from population-scale trajectories and use them prospectively on held-out scientific-development decisions beyond strongest science-of-science, sequence-model and parent controls?

studies.name: POPULATION_CORPUS_AND_BIAS_AUDIT
studies.design: Build source-bound multi-corpus trajectories with explicit publication, citation, field, language, career, institution and missing-failure bias receipts.

studies.name: DEVELOPMENT_OPERATOR_DISCOVERY
studies.design: Infer candidate transition operators from temporally ordered scientific-development trajectories without using post-outcome fame labels during operator induction.

studies.name: SUCCESS_FAILURE_CONTRASTS
studies.design: Construct matched/stratified positive-negative trajectory contrasts conditional on field, epoch, resources, topic maturity and available observables.

studies.name: CROSS_FIELD_AND_CROSS_EPOCH_REPLICATION
studies.design: Test candidate principles on held-out scientific fields and later epochs with frozen outcome definitions and alternative proxies.

studies.name: RECURSIVE_ABSTRACTION_LEVELS
studies.design: Construct L1 operators, L2 operator families, L3 meta-policies and higher candidate levels; each higher level must add held-out prediction, compression without critical loss, prospective generativity or resource benefit.

studies.name: KNOWN_META_REGULARITY_REPLICATION
studies.design: Reproduce and challenge established large-scale candidate regularities such as conventional-plus-atypical combinations, innovation-risk tradeoffs, exploration-to-exploitation transitions and team-size niches using alternative corpora/outcomes.

studies.name: PROSPECTIVE_META_POLICY_ON_GENERATED_RESEARCH_EPISODES
studies.design: Use a frozen learned meta-policy to choose among exploration, exploitation, transfer search, formalism search, experiment/proof, parent deference or abstention on fresh hidden-outcome research episodes.

studies.name: PROSPECTIVE_NATURALISTIC_RESEARCH_DIRECTION
studies.design: On real bounded research programmes, freeze candidate principles before later evidence; compare recommended research-development moves with strongest expert/meta-science/F0 controls.

studies.name: RECURSIVE_STABILITY_CHALLENGE
studies.design: Attempt another abstraction level, new domain, new epoch and hostile omission route. Stop only when no material residual is found under the declared universe, while retaining reopen conditions.

recursive_promotion_rule: A higher abstraction level is retained only if it adds held-out predictive/generative/transfer/resource value or stronger compression without losing registered critical distinctions.
